imaginexr.summary: Led the creation of a virtual LXP campus for digital-sector apprentices, combining a web platform, educational content, support services, generative AI and XR.

sections.title: Project leadership
items: Definition of objectives, scope, resources, organisation and roadmap.
Requirements gathering and drafting of functional and technical specifications.
Presentation of solutions, decision management and validation of deliverables with the client.
Direct and matrix coordination of a multidisciplinary team averaging eleven people.

sections.title: Direct contributions
items: Design and development of parts of the backend using TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.
Migration of the backend to TypeScript, Zod validation, authentication-token redesign, API access keys and server-side pagination.
Design of the architecture and protocols for several generative-AI providers.
Development of backend code, a processing queue and administration interfaces.
Development of selected React and Tailwind CSS interfaces.

sections.title: State at the end of the contract
paragraphs: The backend and AI ecosystem were operational, four XR applications were complete and the user interface was approximately 80% complete, with three secondary areas remaining.

kcl-molecular-communication.role: Postdoctoral Research Associate — public presentation: R&D Project Manager
kcl-molecular-communication.summary: Created a molecular-communication laboratory and an operational testbed combining chemistry, microfluidics, instrumentation, electronics, signal processing and machine learning.

sections.title: Laboratory and team
items: Creation of the laboratory from scratch: premises, equipment, fume hoods, consumables, safety and protocols.
An average team of five people and nine people trained in total.

sections.title: Funding and outcomes
items: Management of two EPSRC grants of €300,000 and €60,000.
Development of a one-dimensional CNN using Python, TensorFlow and scikit-learn to analyse UV-Vis signals.
Design and manufacture of six open-source syringe pumps using Fusion 360, 3D printing, Arduino, I²C, C++ and Python.

kcl-iscat.role: Postdoctoral Research Associate — public presentation: R&D Project Manager
kcl-iscat.summary: Led a €500,000 project to build, qualify and operate a complete iSCAT microscope.

sections.title: Project leadership and team
items: Project funded by the BBSRC and co-funded by Oxford Nanopore Technologies.
Management of three doctoral researchers and two Master’s interns.

sections.title: Instrument and software
items: Construction of the microscope from component procurement through qualification.
Development of LabVIEW control and automation software.
Design of protocols, samples, experiments, acquisition and analysis.
Operational microscope delivered.

strasbourg-mllpa.role: R&D Project Manager / Postdoctoral Research Associate
strasbourg-mllpa.summary: Provided scientific and operational direction for work on lipid membranes, molecular simulation and machine learning, while leading the development of MLLPA.

sections.title: Research
items: Planning of methods, milestones and scientific direction with a high degree of autonomy.
GROMACS simulations of lipid membranes and phase transitions.
Machine-learning approaches followed by a 3D CNN using TensorFlow.

sections.title: MLLPA
items: Development of approximately 95% of the code.
Creation of the entire website and documentation.
Related work continued with collaborators.
